blocks.text:
After breakfast, take a sightseeing tour with an English-speaking guide.

Around La Moneda Palace, the city has a formal feel: its restrained façade and spacious square form the government district.

Plaza de Armas is livelier. Here you will find the cathedral, the post office and historic administrative buildings.

Next, climb Santa Lucía Hill. Its terraces overlook the city centre and the Andes.

The tour continues along the Mapocho River through Vitacura, Las Condes and Providencia.

An optional trip to the wineries of the Maipo Valley can also be arranged.

**Price:** USD 230 per person, minimum 2 participants.

blocks.text: Santiago – Calama – San Pedro de Atacama

provenance.rationale: Combined the exact Word departure, flight and onward-transfer place names in the current RU route order.

blocks.text:
Transfer to the airport for a flight to northern Chile.

In Calama, the air becomes much drier and there is almost no greenery. Continue by road through the desert to San Pedro de Atacama.

San Pedro is a small settlement of low adobe houses, with volcanoes on the horizon. The earth changes from grey to copper, with salt patches and folds of the Cordillera appearing nearby.

The jeep journey across the Altiplano begins the following day.

An astronomical tour is available at an additional cost. The dry climate, altitude and low light pollution make it possible to see the Milky Way, Southern Hemisphere constellations, planets and distant galaxies clearly.

**Price:** USD 350 per person, minimum 2 participants.
